Elephant Trunk Hill is the iconic landmark and one of the most popular attractions in Guilin. It is located not far from the Sun and Moon Pagodas. Visitors can admire the unique shape of the hill, which resembles an elephant drinking water from the river. You can simply stand along the riverbank to enjoy the beautiful view, hike up the hill to see the scenery from above, or take a small boat ride along the river for a different perspective of this natural wonder. It’s a must-visit spot when traveling to Guilin.

Last month I just visited this place and very beautiful area Elephant Trunk Hill is named that way because the hill’s natural shape looks exactly like an elephant drinking water 🌊🐘. Why is it called Elephant Trunk Hill? The hill resembles a giant elephant standing by a river. Its “trunk” dips down into the water, as if the elephant is drinking. The arch between the “trunk” and the “body” forms a cave called Water Moon Cave, which reflects beautifully on the river at night. In Chinese, it’s called Xiangbishan (象鼻山): Xiang (象) = Elephant Bi (鼻) = Trunk Shan (山) = Hill And located at the confluence of Taohua River and Lu River in Guilin City Guangi ZHUANG The main scenic spots in Xiangshan area Include Water Moon Cave, Elepahant Eye Rock, Puxian Pagoda, Yunfeng Temple

"Elephant Trunk Hill, located at the confluence of Taohua River and Li River in Guilin City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, is named because the shape of the hill resembles an elephant drinking water by the river and is known as the symbol of Guilin's landscape. The main scenic spots in Xiangshan Scenic Area include Water Moon Cave, Elephant Eye Rock, Puxian Pagoda, Yunfeng Temple, and the exhibition hall of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Revolutionary Site in the temple. Water Moon Cave is close to the riverside, and the Li River flows through it, like a floating moon in the water. One scholar in Jibei of the Song Dynasty wrote a poem Water Moon Cave Rhyme which was carved on the cave, saying "In the water, there is a bright moon, over the water, there is a floating moon. The water is flowing, while the moon is still there. The moon is gone, while the water is still flowing." The poem graphically depicts the beautiful scenery of the Water Moon Cave. In 2017, it was rated as a national AAAAA tourist attraction, covering an area of 118,800 square metres. It is a natural scenic spot of Karst landform. It has been a famous tourist attraction since the Tang Dynasty and has a tourist history of more than 1,000 years."

Elephant Hill Scenic Area is one of the most famous tourist attractions in Guilin. The name of this place is derived from rocky mountains that resemble the shape of an elephant, although it is not exactly 100% like an elephant but we can imagine the shape that approaches the shape of an elephant. Where these rocky elephants also have fairy tales, in short the elephant is an elephant from the Heavenly Kingdom who is said to have been a long time ago that the Emperor's Sky was coming down and playing to the city of Guilin. The Elephant was very fascinated by the beauty of the city of Guilin, so that when the Jade Emperor returned to its place, the Elephant remained on the earth and became an elephant-shaped stone. This place has a beautiful view with cool and fresh air in October. Lots of photo spots here. When you visit China and to the city of Guilin this place is one of the places to visit. If you like to shop on foot there is a shopping place close to this extraordinary place especially at night.

There is an old story that circulates among the Guilin people. It is said that Xiangbi Mountain ie: Elephant Trunk Hill (象鼻山) is the embodiment of a God Elephant, who used to be the mount of the Emperor of Heaven. It was separated from the Emperor in a war and stranded in Guilin (桂林) with severe wounds. A local couple saved its life and took good care of it. This animal fell in love with the life there and decided not to return to the heavenly palace. The Emperor bestowed a pagoda to help it suppress evils and protect people. Since then, it never left this place and at last became Elephant Trunk Hill. The Puxian Pagoda on the top is said to be the bestowed one. While officially, Elephant Trunk Hill (Chinese: 象鼻山; pinyin: Xiàngbí Shān) is a hill, landmark and tourist attraction in Guilin, Guangxi, China. Elephant Trunk Hill is the symbol of the city of Guilin. It got its name because it looks like an elephant drinking water. The round opening that would be under the elephant’s trunk is known as Water-Moon Cave because at night the reflection of the moon can be seen through the arch and it looks as if it is under the water and floating on the surface of the water at the same time. Elephant Trunk Hill and Water-Moon Cave are located at the confluence of the Taohua River and the Lijiang River.

Tömeg... Az Elefántormány-hegy a Li-folyó és a Taohuajiang-folyó találkozásánál magasodik. A sziklaképződmény magassága 55 méter, így inkább dombnak tekinthető. Különös formája teszi egyedivé, ami egy, a folyóból ivó elefántra emlékeztet. A domb mélyén húzódik a Shuiyue-barlang, amelyet magyarul Vízi Hold-barlangnak fordítanak. Az Elefántormány-hegy megmászható, ahonnan gyönyörű panorámában gyönyörködhetünk, illetve felfedezhetjük a belsejében húzódó barlangrendszert is. A hegy tetején levő kétszintes, 14 m magas Puxian-pagoda a Ming-dinasztia idején épült. A pagodát zöldellő fák veszik körül. A pagoda második szintjének északi oldalán található Puxian, azaz Samanthabadra bódhiszattva képe. A pagoda messziről úgy néz ki, mint egy finom, drága váza egy elefánt hátán. Legendája: A császár egyszer szemlét tartott Guilinban, kíséretéhez számtalan óriás elefánt is tartozott. Az egyik állatot azonban a betegsége miatt magára hagytak és így lemaradt a többiektől. A falusiak megsajnálták az állatot és ápolni kezdték. Miután meggyógyult, szorgalmasan dolgozott, segített a parasztoknak. Amint ezt megtudta a császár szörnyű haragra gerjedt és elrendelte, hogy öljék meg az állatot. Az elefánt a végsőkig küzdött, mígnem kőheggyé változott. A pagoda ott áll, ahova a császára kardját markolatig az elefántba döfte.

Elephant Trunk Hill / Bukit Belalai Gajah (Xiangbishan) merupakan ciri khas atau landmark kota Guilin yg sangat terkenal. Terletak di Area pertemuan Sungai Taohua dan Sungai Li , yang merupakan tempat wisata terkenal sejak Dinasti Tang (618 - 907). jika kita perhatikan dg baik bentuk bukit ini seperti bentuk gajah raksasa yang sedang minum air sungai. Bukan hanya pemandangan indah yg mengelilingi bukit ini, namun juga terdapat beberapa bangunan bersejarah yang dapat dikunjungi wisatawan, yaitu : Pagoda Puxian, Kuil Yunfeng, dan Sarira Dagoba. Berdasarkan legenda masyarakat setempat, diceritakan bahwa Bukit Belalai Gajah adalah perwujudan dari Dewa Gajah yang merupakan kendaraan dari Kaisar Langit. Dewa gajah ini terpisah dari Kaisar langit ketika terjadi peperangan dan terdampar di Guilin dalam keadaan ter luka parah. Sepasang suami istri penduduk desa berhasil menyelamatkannya dan merawatnya dengan baik. setelah sembuh hewan ini jatuh cinta dengan kehidupan di desa sehingga tidak ingin kembali ke istana langit. Kaisar kemudian memberikan pagoda untuk membantunya menekan kejahatan dan melindungi orang. Pagoda Puxian yang terletak di atas bukit diriwayatkan sebagai anugerah dari kaisar langit. Pada malam - malam tertentu diadakan pertunjukan malam yang sangat menarik, menggunakan tubuh Bukit Belalai Gajah sebagai layar proyeksi. Pertunjukan ini menggunakan teknologi modern seperti hypermedia, laser dan efek cahaya, untuk mengkomunikasikan pemandangan yang indah dan budaya asli kota Guilin. Pertunjukan ini menampilkan 4 bagian, yaitu : Primitive Guilin, Mysterious Village, Phantom Theater, dan yang terakhir Legend of God Elephant. Pada bagian akhir pertunjukan ditampilkan atraksi sinar laser yg menggambarkan pemandangan bukit dewa gajah yang spektakuler. Bagi pengunjung dari luar yang ingin datang ke tempat ini dapat menggunakan kendaraan umum, yaitu bus 2, 16, 23, atau Bus Wisata 1 dan turun di Stasiun Taman Xiangshan.
